title: MART: Improving LLM Safety with Multi-round Automatic Red-Teaming

bias_targets.target: General Bias, Toxicity, and Harmful Stereotypes
bias_targets.methodology: Calculating overall safety violation rates on adversarial prompt benchmarks (SafeEval, Anthropic Harmless) using an automated safety reward model and human evaluation to flag unsafe, stereotyped, toxic, or unethical generations.
